_comment: Feeds the item_style helper column (scripts/build_item_style.py). One column for flavoured rice AND soup: a week should not repeat a style. Default style comes from sub_category; `exceptions` override one dish by its item name when sub_category gets it wrong.

exceptions._comment: Plain 'Veg Soup' reads as a clear soup to guests even though the ontology files it as chunky; it and sweet_basil_clear_soup are different dishes that share the clear style, so only one of them (or clear_soup / clear_veg_soup) may appear in a week. clear_soup and clear_veg_soup are the same dish under two names; both stay in the ontology because client history refers to them.
